verdict.rationale: Alacritty's TOML config lets you set colors as #RRGGBB hex values, and theme files can be imported, so color schemes are supported. Live config reload is on by default, which helps when swapping themes. Nothing in the evidence shows automatic light/dark mode switching, which is half of the story. Missing for 10: automatic light/dark switching tied to the OS appearance, a documented theme/scheme mechanism beyond raw hex colors and imports, and independent corroboration.
